column1: # Incoming world-opcode registrations of the 3.3.5a client (WoW.exe build 12340).
# The dispatcher at 0x63200b accepts ids below 0x51f, indexes the handler array at session+0x53c,
# and calls it at 0x63202c. The parallel context array is at session+0x19b8. Registration function
# 0x631fa0 fills both arrays; most callers use wrapper 0x6b0b80.
# One row is one literal registration callsite. Repeated opcode ids are retained: they describe real lifecycle
# registrations rather than a guessed final table. `context=dyn` means the context was pushed from a register.
# `direct_events` lists literal-id FrameScript fires inside the registered handler's conservative function
# extent. Shared handlers can serve several opcodes, so these are handler facts, not unconditional packet effects.
# Symbolic names are blank unless the exact handler directly proves the name through a matching event. No server
# or other-client opcode enum fills the blanks. `handler-event` is the only current name confidence.
# 611 registrations; 610 opcode ids; 324 handlers; 225 rows with direct events; 7 named rows.
